version.description: Document version the action applied to (from after.version); null for non-document rows and legacy rows without a version

linkHint.description: Frontend deep-link hint, e.g. /review/<id>; null when no route is known. The web client appends ?version=N for versioned rows.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when exhausted

fullName.description: Name from the LK projection, matched only by JWT code1c/uuid

shortName.description: Compact display name ("Фамилия И.О.") derived from fullName

avatarUrl.description: User avatar URL enriched server-side from LK, null when unavailable

submittedAt.description: Successful submission time, UTC ISO 8601; null when historically unknown

reviewedAt.description: Approval or return decision time, UTC ISO 8601

reviewedBy.description: Verified JWT UUID of the reviewer

supersededByVersion.description: Newer current version, or null while this returned version is still current

requiredDocuments.description: Applicable catalog document types for positionCode+citizenship; null when positionCode is unknown

token.description: Five-minute upload capability; keep in memory only

x.description: Normalized left coordinate after image EXIF/PDF page rotation

text.description: Original OCR text in this region, never changed by manual corrections

ocrText.description: Unformatted OCR field text for exact comparison; originalValue is the typed suggestion

fileOrdinal.description: Zero-based source file position; null for bundle-level issues

pageNumber.description: One-based page number within source file

responseBody.description: Bounded ERP response text with credentials and file contents redacted; historical responses are unavailable
